tenderAddress.blockNumber: O/o Executive Engineer No. 1 Division KSDB Bangalore. #55 Rishaldar street Sheshadripuram Bangalore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
Labours must and should wear the Uniform In working Hours.
The Agencies should upload Establishment Registration certificate (Valid License copy).
The Agencies should upload Pan card/GST Registration certificate.
The Agencies should upload Valid Goods and Service Tax Registration certificate.
The Agencies should upload Valid E.P.F and E.S.I Registration certificate.
The Agencies should upload Valid Registration / License obtained with the Labour department.
The Agencies should upload Valid PSARA Licene Registration certificate (License from Police Department).
The Executive Engineer, No.1 Division, KSDB Bangalore has rights to accept or reject any of tenders without giving any reasons

The details and other information will be made available in Executive Engineer, No.1 Division KSDB, Bangalore office which can be collected during office hours. And also can see in the tender document.

To qualify for award of this contract, the Agencies should upload Financial turn over in its name for last Five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25, &2025-26. Submit the scanned copy of the profit & loss statement indicating the contract receipts certified by the chartered account. Upload Turnover certificate which showing the 5 years turnover and should certified by the chartered account with UDIN Number also.
Rates in BOQ which are except GST (ESI & PF of Employer Share) and will pay to the tendered amount separately.
Toilets shall be cleaned Three Times in a day and well before commencement office time i.e, 9 am in the morning and 12.30 pm and 4.00pm in the afternoon.
In case of exceptional circumstances additional cleaning shall be done wherever necessary with no additional cost.
Successful Tendered shall additional cleaning work, shifting of furniture, arrangements of seats, during official program of the KSDB. It is part and parcel.

Premises of Department means the office of the commissioner KSDB No55 Risaldar street, sheshadripuram, Bangalore, whenever in this contract the words Directed, Required, Ordered, Desired, Considered, Necessary, or like words are used, it shall be understood that the directions, requirements, permissions, order etc., of the commissioner KSDB, No55 Risaldar street sheshadripuram, Bangalore or other authorized officers of the Department, as the case may be

Qualification of Security Guards and Lift Operators : Security Guards and lift operators deployed by the Agency must be literate and know how to operate Diesel Generator Set, Lifts and Well Trained for rescue operation like fire or any accident in the building . Experience certificate of Security Guards and Lift Operators must be produced. Their age must be between 21 and 45 years. They must be physically fit enough to keep strict vigil over the security of the department. Suitability of the Security Guards and Lift Operators will be decided by the Executive Engineer No 1 Division of KSDB, Bangalore.

The Security Guards and Lift Operators deployed by the Agency shall be the employees of the Agency concerned and they shall not have any connections with the employees of the Department. The Department will not be responsible for any un-authorized acts of the Security Guards and for any damage/injury sustained by the Security Guard in the course of his work/duty.

The Contractor shall make the payment of wages/salaries to Security Guards and Lift Operators deployed through individual Bank Account only and shall arrange to remit all statutory deductions like Professions Tax, GST, ESI/PF to the designated authorities along with the Agency contribution as per law, at the applicable rates within the stipulated time limits

The Agency shall also produce the documents for having paid PF/ESI contribution towards each employees account along with Agencies contribution to the designated Authorities, from time to time. The agency will be fully and solely responsible for any violations under the above statutes. If it fails to do so, it will be a breach of contract and the Corporation at its discretion can cancel the contract. The Agency shall also be liable for any pecuniary liability arising on account of any violation of the provisions of the relevant laws.

The Agency shall submit the PT, PF and ESI remittance challans of the Security Guard and Lift Operators deployed under this contract separately with specific remittance details of PT, PF and ESI contributions to the statutory authorities at the agreed rates along with the subsequent monthly bills. The agency shall also submit the copy of remittance of GST to the appropriate authorities along with the bills.

The Agency shall disburse the salary to its personnel deployed as quoted in Schedule I annexed to the tender documents. The Agency shall further agree that it would make timely payment of wages to its employees without un-authorized deductions and shall also be responsible to fulfill all statutory obligations such as remittance of PF/ESI etc., in respect of its Security Guards and Lift Operators posted under this contract. If it fails to do so, it will be a breach of contract and the Corporation at its discretion can cancel the contract. The Agency shall also be liable for any pecuniary liability arising on account of any violation of the provisions of the relevant laws.
The Agency shall furnish half yearly/yearly returns, employee wise, showing details of amount of statutory payments such as PT, ESI & PF remitted to the concerned authorities.

The Agency shall issue Photo ID cards to all its employees with the agencies Logo & Name and Designation of the employee deployed and Uniform, Shoes, Cap, Torchlight, Whistle and police verification letter within a period of 15 days.

If any personnel employed by the Agency are considered undesirable by the Department, it shall be the responsibility of the Agency to remove the said person or persons from the work. Such persons cannot be re-deployed by the Agency for any other work of the Department without the specific permission of the Department.
The Agency should not sublet the contract. If the Agency is found to have sublet the contact, the contract will be terminated at the risk and cost of the contractor concerned.

In case of any ambiguity or doubts with regard to the terms, clauses used in the tender documents, clarifications should be sought in writing, before submitting the tenders, failing which, the decision of the Department in all such matters shall be final and binding on the Agency.

The agencies shall take care while submitting the rates to each security guard and Lift Operators by incorporating prevailing minimum wages, applicable statutory payments, and uniform etc. administrative expenses.
The agency shall remain liable for payment of all wages or other costs due to its employees under the minimum Wages Act, Works Men Compensation Act, PF Act, ESI Act etc

The Department shall not be held responsible or called upon to make good any losses/costs incurred by Agency on account of factors beyond its control such as legal implications, accidents, illegal actions of the Security Guards and Lift Operators deployed, etc., or for any reason whatsoever
The scope of service is liable for alteration by way of deletions or additions at the discretion of the Department

The Department including the authorized Officers of the Department shall have the power to issue notice in writing and to instruct/direct the agency to make alterations/variations in the assigned work/change the deployed staff

The Agency shall obey all relevant Central, State and local regulations and enactments pertaining to contract personnel and the Executive Engineer No 1 Division of KSDB shall have the right to inquire into and decide all complaints on such matters
Successful Tenderer shall do the dusting of roof, windows, curtains, doors at least once in a week
Supplying of the materials is provided by KSDB and records should be maintained for the issue of materials in presence of AE/JE. The room should not be used for any other purpose

If the Agency fails to provide the Security Guards and Lift Operators services satisfactorily during the currency of the contract, the Department shall have the power to enter upon and take possession of the works and engage any other person, firm or agency to complete the work. Any extra cost incurred by the Department due to such failure on the part of the Agency shall be recovered from the Agency.

The antecedents of the staff engaged by the Agency for deployment should be verified through local police or by any other Government Agency and shall be responsible for the good conduct of its staff while on duty as well as off duty in Departments premises and the staff shall behave like responsible persons at all times. The staff should not be found developing familiarity with the employees of the Department

The Agency will be held responsible for all the acts of the Security Guards with all risks arising from carelessness, negligence or damage or loss by theft, pilferage etc. and the agency shall undertake to compensate the losses arising from such acts of Security Guards to all the concerned including KSDB Department

The Agency shall arrange a training program/workshop to the Security Guards and Lift Operators at the beginning of the contract to make them understand the nature of work they shall carry by inviting the experts in the field and officers of the KSDB Department

Rates which are shown in BOQ for Man Powers supply (such as: Sweepers, Toilet cleaners, Electrician, Labour For Sanitization, Lift Operators, Security guards) are Minimum wages rates, Hence agencies should not quote less than minimum wages rates which are shown in BOQ for man power supply

The Agencies should have provided Security Guards and Lift Operators, Sweepers, Toilet cleaners to one or more State/Central Government Organizations undertakings/ Corporation for the last two years and should have rendered services satisfactorily

Rates which are shown in BOQ for Man Powers supply (such as: Sweepers,Toilet cleaners,Electrician,Labour For Sanitization, Lift Operators, Security guards) are Minimum wages rates, Hence agencies should not quote less than minimum wages rates which are shown in BOQ for man power supply

The bid shall be in Rupees of total wages and not in value. No Freak Bid (Bids that are impractically low i.e. zero / near to zero) shall not be allowed and any bid treated as freak bid will be summarily rejected
